experiment: C3E1 - directed (one-sided) energy ejection from a C3 three-sphere cluster in a 3-D jammed frictional sphere medium
status: pre-registered before any physics run of c3e1_run.py (no exploratory runs; thresholds below are fixed and will not be moved)
claim_under_test: Author: 'in a 3-D structure, when energy concentrates, the three spheres (the C3 triangle) cause the energy to be expelled to ONE side; in physics there is no outlet, so it is annihilated. The 82 (=81+1) structure continues into fluids.' Existing support (fluid s4, s11 corotation.py / rigid_shell.py, physics s8.0) is graph-2-coloring and Gauss-theorem arguments, i.e. true by construction; no dynamical 3-D run exists.

model.type: 3-D discrete-element (DEM) soft frictional spheres: translational + rotational DOF (the lattice itself, no continuum closure)
model.spheres: monodisperse diameter d = 1, mass m = 1, moment of inertia I = (2/5) m (d/2)^2
model.normal_contact: harmonic k_n = 1 on overlap delta, normal dashpot gamma_n = 0.05 on normal relative velocity, force clamped >= 0
model.tangential_contact: viscous-Coulomb: F_t = -gamma_t v_slip, gamma_t = 0.5, capped at mu F_n, mu = 0.5 (no tangential spring / no contact history)
model.integrator: velocity Verlet, dt = 0.02 (units d, m, sqrt(m/k_n)); contact candidates from periodic cKDTree, cutoff 1.2 d, rebuilt every 25 steps
model.boundary: fully periodic box = a CLOSED domain (no outlet anywhere)

media.A_FCC: perfect FCC crystal, 4*12^3 = 6912 spheres, nearest-neighbour distance 0.98 d (uniform prestress overlap 0.02). Deterministic, exact lattice symmetry. The (111) contact triangle has site symmetry C3v: one tetrahedral CAP sphere on one side of the triangle, one octahedral HOLE on the other (the only lattice-given 'nozzle' candidate).
media.B_RCP: random jammed packing (the framework's vacuum): N = 4000 frictionless spheres random-placed at phi = 0.66 (> phi_J ~ 0.64) and FIRE-minimised; 2 packings x 6 cluster sites = 12 realizations per configuration. Disorder breaks all symmetry, so the cluster-intrinsic part is isolated by averaging the dipole vector in the CLUSTER frame (disorder part averages out ~1/sqrt(12)).
media.C_SC81: simple-cubic crystal, 16^3 spheres, spacing 0.98 d; the 81-core = sites with x^2+y^2+z^2 <= 6 (81 = 3^4; R^2 = 7 empty).

injection_put_in_by_hand: at t = 0 the chosen cluster spheres are given spin only (no translation), total injected energy E0 = sum (1/2) I omega^2 with |omega| (d/2) = 0.2 per sphere; medium at rest. Spin axis = cluster normal (triangle normal; for pair/single a random axis perpendicular to the bond / random).

configurations.T+++: contact triangle, all three co-rotating about the triangle normal (C3; the author's co-rotating core; 3 frustrated contacts)
configurations.T+-+: contact triangle, spins +,-,+ (minimal frustration: exactly ONE frustrated contact = the '+1 nozzle' of corotation.py)
configurations.P++: contact pair co-rotating (1 frustrated contact, no three-body frustration)
configurations.P+-: contact pair counter-rotating (bipartite, 0 frustrated contacts; gear-meshed)
configurations.C81co: SC 81-core all co-rotating about z (medium C only)
configurations.C81chk: SC 81-core checkerboard counter-rotating (bipartite control, medium C only)

observable.flux: energy flux across the sphere of radius R_s = 3 d around the cluster centroid: for each contact (i inside, j outside) flux_ij = (1/2)(P_on_j - P_on_i), P = F.v + tau.omega (translational + rotational work); time-integrated over t in [0, T_w], T_w = 10 (before periodic wrap-around returns to the shell)
observable.angular_weights: flux assigned to the unit direction of the contact point from the centroid; accumulated on 400 Fibonacci direction bins
observable.D: dipole = |sum w n| / sum w (w = net outgoing flux). 0 isotropic or two opposite equal lobes; 0.5 uniform hemisphere; 1 single delta lobe
observable.q: quadrupole = 1.5 * largest eigenvalue of sum w (n n^T - I/3) / sum w (0 isotropic, 1 single axis, either one or two lobes)
observable.lobe: f_lobe = max over directions of fraction of positive flux within a 60 deg cone (isotropic 0.25); bipolarity b = cone(-n_max)/cone(n_max) (~1 two opposite lobes, ~0.33 or less one lobe)
observable.D_sys_B: medium B: |mean over realizations of dipole VECTOR in the cluster frame| / mean total flux (cluster-intrinsic directedness); D_run_B = mean per-run D (includes disorder-induced anisotropy)

symmetry_facts_F: S in FCC (O_h site) and P++ / P+- bond midpoint in FCC: dipole components forbidden along the axes fixed by the site symmetry; S: D = 0 exactly
T+++ in FCC: C3 about [111] forbids any in-plane dipole; a dipole ALONG [111] is allowed only because the cap/hole asymmetry breaks the mirror (lattice-given, not three-body-given)
T+++ with an isolated mirror-symmetric environment: D = 0 exactly (C3 + sigma_h); therefore any one-sided ejection must come from the environment or from spontaneous symmetry breaking
C81co in SC: C4h symmetry -> D = 0 exactly; one lobe requires spontaneous symmetry breaking (tested by epsilon position noise)
closed periodic box: total linear momentum is conserved (Newton III) -> no net momentum can be ejected; net flux through the box boundary is 0 by construction

predictions.P1_triangle_one_lobe_RCP: T+++ in medium B: D_sys_B >= 0.25 AND mean f_lobe >= 0.45 AND mean b <= 0.5
predictions.P2_controls_not_directed_RCP: P++, P+-, S in medium B: D_sys_B <= 0.10 each, AND D_sys_B(T+++) >= 2 x max(D_sys_B of P++, P+-, S)
predictions.P3_triangle_one_lobe_FCC: T+++ in medium A: D >= 0.25 with direction within 20 deg of the [111] axis (cap or hole side, sign reported); S and P++ in A: D <= 0.02 (code-symmetry sanity)
predictions.P4_nozzle_contact: T+-+ (one frustrated contact) is MORE directed than T+++: D_sys_B(T+-+) > D_sys_B(T+++)  (author's '+1 nozzle' reading)
predictions.P5_closed_box_annihilation: T+++ in medium A run to T = 200: |P_total| / (m*omega*d/2) < 1e-8 at all times; energy balance E_mech + E_diss = E0 closes to 1e-3 relative; late-time (t in [150,200]) dipole of the medium kinetic-energy distribution around the centroid <= 0.10 (direction lost); fraction of E0 dissipated by t = 200 reported (prediction: >= 0.5)
predictions.P6_81core_spontaneous_lobe: C81co in medium C with random position noise epsilon = 1e-4 d: D >= 0.25 (spontaneous single lobe). Control C81chk same noise: D <= 0.10. Also D(eps=1e-6) reported to test amplification (D proportional to eps = no spontaneous selection)

decision_rule: each prediction PASS/FAIL as written; failures are recorded, not re-tuned. Parameters above are fixed; if a run is numerically unstable (energy error > 1e-2 without dissipation accounted) it is reported as INVALID, and dt halved once, stated.
